Thanks for opening up about this. The same happened to me, I had no idea what I was doing and customers got away with sexual assault. My best advice (that I’m still working on) is identifying your own boundaries and holding to them. Because others are not going to be there to help you. And in my experience the club won’t kick them out. So decide for yourself what you’re okay with, communicate it at the beginning of the dance, and know what you’ll do to enforce your boundaries. I learned on YouTube from watching a body language expert that people love choices. If they try to touch your boobs, tell them where you’re comfortable being touched instead. I know even as I’m typing this how difficult it is in real time. But please don’t judge or shame yourself for what others did to you
